mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.slot_version_id, c.defect_id, c.author_id, c.body, c.created_at, c.edited_at, c.deleted_at, a.name AS author_name, a.tier AS author_tier FROM comment c JOIN account a ON a.id = c.author_id WHERE c.slot_version_id = #{versionId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at, c.id
SELECT id, slot_version_id, defect_id, author_id, body, created_at, edited_at, deleted_at FROM comment WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (slot_version_id, author_id, body) VALUES (#{slotVersionId}, #{authorId}, #{body})
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET body = #{body}, edited_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE comment SET deleted_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
